ALL 15 typed-choice families (aaday aaddmm aaseason aaspan aaways aaweek ab24h abenough abunit abwunit acmcmp adrace aeampm aewcmp avvcmp; 3,557 questions) are Unsupported: export.ts writes the lettered options only for the separate :mc presentation of non-choice families, so for typed choice questions the options and their order are not in $DATA and the letter cannot be checked. Option order is shuffled per question (verified by cross-tabulating key letters against the derived outcome). Fix: re-export with the options of the typed choice item. Meanwhile refs run the statement/figure consistency checks they can (calendar picture vs datetime, seasons table vs IMD, table vs statement).

Figures are treated as part of the statement. Where a figure carries the data (bars, tables, coins, number lines, clocks, calendars, balances) the answer is read from the figure and the statement numbers are required to agree with it; any disagreement would be reported as a mismatch (none found).
Calendar pictures (aacalc aacald aacalgap aacalmo aaday) were checked cell by cell against Python datetime.

aaseq / aadur use my own common-sense ordering of the activities (aaseq: wakes up < breakfast < school < lunch at school < back home < play < dinner < bed; aadur: laces 10 s < teeth 2 min < lunch 25 min < film 2 h < night sleep 8 h < school week < summer holidays); only the order matters and no ties occur.
abmeas mm variant: key reads the labelled numbers as centimetres (see register, Ambiguous).
amseg / amcshape / amcombs etc. use the pi (and sqrt3) value stated in each question with exact rational arithmetic; stored answers are exact for those values.

Realisability checks applied (Verdict False if violated; none triggered): polygon inequality (adperim, admper), triangle inequality (amheron, amherq), cyclic-quadrilateral existence (ambrahma), parallelogram slant >= height (aipara), right-pyramid apex consistency of the two slant heights (ampyrp), slant > apothem (ampyrp, ampyrs), tent slope > radius (ammodel), L-shape outline sides (ailshape), arc/sector angle in (0,360) (amsecinv), path narrower than half the garden (aipath), inner < outer radius (aihollow, amshell).

Word forms: answer equality with the typed form is checked by the runner for every question (wordBad 0). Wording was read for one question per family (about 125 stories): numbers, units and the quantity asked were consistent with the typed answer in all of them; wording of the other word forms is not verified.
Multiple-choice forms (:mc): checked by the runner for every non-choice question that matched (32,935 checks, 0 bad: exactly one option equals the derived answer and it is the keyed one).

Sensitivity check: for 116 non-choice families the first 40 stored answers were corrupted (+1 / swapped / appended) and re-run through the same refs: 0 of the mutated questions passed, 0 reference errors.
